name_reason: Accurately names the master spell-cast animation+damage orchestrator. Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=play, matching its sibling playback helpers fd2_play_figani_animation_loop / fd2_play_char_intro_zoom_anim / fd2_play_palette_fade_to_black / fd2_play_sfx_with_handle that this file uses); descriptor 'spell_cast_sequence' matches the function's role of running the full cast cinematic and applying spell damage. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Master 'big spell cast' animation + damage-application orchestrator for basic spells: frees scratch caches, loads the BG/TAI backdrop + caster and per-target FIGANI streams + the spell-specific FDOTHER effect, then runs the multi-phase cast cinematic (driven by a per-spell fn-ptr handler table) while applying and HP-bar-lerping fd2_calc_magic_damage to each target; finally frees everything and reloads the battle-scene caches. Summon spells (id>=0x20) and sword-skills (id==0x18 or 0x1C..0x1F) are forwarded to dedicated handlers.
logic_summary: Top-level dispatch on spell_id: >=0x20 -> fd2_execute_summon_spell_cast; ==0x18 or in [0x1C..0x1F] -> fd2_execute_special_attack_skill; otherwise inline. Inline: (1) copy 6 .rodata const tables to stack (shake X/Y offsets, HP-lerp hit counts, player/enemy team caster sprite-id tables, intro SFX-bank table), set palette_op_base/shine_table_offset from spell_id; (2) free portrait_sprite_cache/large_game_state_buffer/battle_scene_snapshot, zero the 30-dword FIGANI stack buffer; (3) resolve bg_idx/tai_idx from per-chapter cinematic-mode override (chapter_combat_cinematic_mode_per_chapter[current_chapter]) or the tile attr byte, swapped by caster.team, plus fd2_resolve_terrain_for_aoe_targets; (4) load BG.DAT[bg_idx], TAI.DAT[tai_idx], caster FIGANI (portrait*3 and +2, falling back to +1 if first int16==0), FDOTHER spell SFX bank, per-target FIGANI, team caster sprite; (5) malloc 64000 backbuffer + 0x2A300 frame-scratch, stamp caster; (6) intro zoom + figani loop; (7) optional spell_id==9 slide-in, then cinematic phases via FF/4 indirect through data_fd2_battle_spell_cast_cinematic_phase_handler_table[spell_id] (5 args caster_idx/team_caster_sprite/work_buf/stride/phase_code, returns this phase's frame count); (8) per-target main loop: snapshot tgt HP, damage=fd2_calc_magic_damage (writes HP, 0=miss via SETZ), restore snapshot, lerp HP bar over hit_count steps toward post-damage value, hit shows shake/flash pose + advances shake state (shake_y_dir=1-(rng%3) from fd2_advance_rng_state EAX) while miss shows the 'miss' frame; (9) post-cast phase-6 loop + spell_id==9 slide-out + final 3-frame shake/shine lerp; (10) free all resources, reallocate large_game_state_buffer (0x25680), reload battle_scene_snapshot from FDSHAP.DAT[tile_event_data[0]*2], restore portrait cache, fade out, clear VGA, composite, fade in.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_play_spell_cast_sequence(uint32 caster_idx, uint32 spell_id, uint32 target_count, uint32 target_ids_arg)

params.name: caster_idx
params.semantics: Runtime-char index of the spell caster; indexes runtime_char_array for the caster portrait/team and forwarded to fd2_flash_char_hit_sprite / fd2_play_char_intro_zoom_anim / the cinematic phase handlers. Both callers pass the casting char index (AI caster / player caster).
params.reason: Correctly names the caster runtime-char index; matches both call sites; no address residue. (Live Ghidra param is the placeholder 'param_1' -> Stage-2 rename to caster_idx.)

params.name: spell_id
params.semantics: Spell id (0x00..0x1F domain id). Selects the top-level dispatch branch, indexes the 6 const tables and the cinematic phase-handler table, and is the spell_id argument to fd2_calc_magic_damage. Both callers pass the selected/AI-chosen spell id.
params.reason: Correctly names the spell id (a meaningful FD2 spell-domain id, not address residue). (Live Ghidra param is the placeholder 'newname_2' -> Stage-2 rename to spell_id.)

params.name: target_count
params.semantics: Number of valid entries in target_ids (the AoE/single target list). Bounds the per-target FIGANI load loop, the main cast loop and the resource-free loop. Both callers pass the n_targets returned by fd2_compute_aoe_targets.
params.reason: Correctly names the target count; matches both call sites; no address residue. (Live Ghidra param is the placeholder 'newname_3' -> Stage-2 rename to target_count.)

params.name: target_ids_arg
params.semantics: Pointer (passed as int) to a byte array of target runtime-char indices; cast to uint8* and indexed target_ids[0..target_count-1] to pick per-target runtime_char_array entries and FIGANI streams. Both callers pass the target_id_buffer filled by fd2_compute_aoe_targets.
params.reason: Correctly identifies the target-id buffer pointer; no address residue. CRITICAL: the live Ghidra 4th param is MISLABELED 'caster_idx' (actively wrong -- it is the target_ids pointer, confirmed at disasm 0x2a98e MOVZX EAX,byte ptr[target_ids] and both call sites). Stage-2 must rename the Ghidra param away from 'caster_idx' to target_ids.

returns.semantics: No return value; output is the cast cinematic painted to VGA mode-13h (0xA0000), the applied spell damage written into runtime_char_array[target].hp_current by fd2_calc_magic_damage, and the reloaded battle-scene caches.
